title: The Lord's Judgment

questions.question: You only have I known of all the families of the earth; therefore I will punish you for all your what?
questions.explanation: Amos 3:2 (ESV): "therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities."

questions.question: Do two walk together, unless they have what?
questions.explanation: Amos 3:3 (ESV): "Do two walk together, unless they have agreed to meet?"

questions.question: Does a lion roar in the forest, when he has no what?
questions.explanation: Amos 3:4 (ESV): "Does a lion roar in the forest, when he has no prey?"

questions.question: The lion has roared; who will not fear? The Lord God has spoken; who can but what?
questions.explanation: Amos 3:8 (ESV): "The Lord God has spoken; who can but prophesy?"

questions.question: An adversary shall surround the land and bring down your defenses, and your strongholds shall be what?
questions.explanation: Amos 3:11 (ESV): "and your strongholds shall be plundered."

questions.question: Complete the saying: "Is a trumpet blown in a city, and the people are not..."?
questions.explanation: Amos 3:6 (ESV): "Is a trumpet blown in a city, and the people are not afraid?"

questions.question: Does disaster come to a city, unless the Lord has done it?
questions.explanation: Amos 3:6 (ESV): "Does disaster come to a city, unless the Lord has done it?"

questions.question: For the Lord God does nothing without revealing his secret to his servants the what?
questions.explanation: Amos 3:7 (ESV): "For the Lord God does nothing without revealing his secret to his servants the prophets."

questions.question: Proclaim to the strongholds in Ashdod and in the land of Egypt, "Assemble yourselves on the mountains of..."?
questions.explanation: Amos 3:9 (ESV): "Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria,"

questions.question: They do not know how to do right, those who store up violence and robbery in their what?
questions.explanation: Amos 3:10 (ESV): "those who store up violence and robbery in their strongholds."

questions.question: As the shepherd rescues from the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear, so shall the people of Israel who dwell in Samaria be rescued, with the corner of a couch and part of a what?
questions.explanation: Amos 3:12 (ESV): "with the corner of a couch and part of a bed."

questions.question: On the day I punish Israel for his transgressions, I will punish the altars of where?
questions.explanation: Amos 3:14 (ESV): "that on the day I punish Israel for his transgressions, I will punish the altars of Bethel,"

questions.question: The horns of the altar shall be cut off and fall to the what?
questions.explanation: Amos 3:14 (ESV): "and the horns of the altar shall be cut off and fall to the ground."

questions.question: I will strike the winter house along with the summer house, and the houses of what shall perish?
questions.explanation: Amos 3:15 (ESV): "and the houses of ivory shall perish,"

questions.question: Hear, and testify against the house of Jacob," declares the Lord God, the God of what?
questions.explanation: Amos 3:13 (ESV): "declares the Lord God, the God of hosts,"

key_verse_text: For the Lord God does nothing without revealing his secret to his servants the prophets.
